content:
nate: Quick alert from nightly perf: small http2 multiplex workload p99 jumped 2x after kselector change. baseline p99 ~75ms -> now ~150ms.
rachel: Did you capture a flame or top stacks?
josh: perf top shows: 22% _emit_frame, 14% kv_lookup_miss, 11% writev, 7% select_kernel_variant.
priya: kselector now routes <=3-token requests to tiny-kernel which disables frame coalescing. That explains writev spike.
nate: Tokenizer also started returning earlier chunks after preparse-eager tweak. Combo looks bad.
rachel: Quick mitigation: enable http2.coalesce_frames=true for muxed path and set kernel hint batch_delay_ms=1. Canary that?
josh: I'll run a focused repro: `./tools/repro --http2 --small-req --qps 250 --duration 60s` and diff KV hitrate + writev rate.
perf-bot: scheduled canary: canary/kselector-tinywrite-fix -> staging at 3600000120 by josh.
priya: If canary recovers p99 and KV hits, we'll land a heuristic patch. Otherwise we revert kselector routing.
nate: Assign actions: josh run canary+bench, rachel correlate tokenizer chunk timing vs KV misses, priya prepare revert branch.
josh: ack, posting results in this thread.
